content: अनेहस् {%a.%} [न हन्यते, हन्-असि, धातोः एहादेशः नञि हन् एह च <ls>Uṇ. 4. 223</ls>] (<ab>lit.</ab>) Not killed or destroyed or obstructed; <ab>Ved.</ab> without a rival, incomparable, unattainable, inaccessible; unobstructed, not liable to be hurt or injured; शंभुवं मन्त्रं देवा अनेहसम् <ls>Rv. 1. 40. 6</ls>, <ls n="Rv. 1. 40.">4</ls>, <ls n="Rv.">6. 50. 3</ls>. --{%m.%} (हा-हसौ <ab>&c.</ab>) Time (not being liable to be destroyed). <ab>cf.</ab> तस्मादनेहसं कंचित्प्रतीक्षस्व महाभुज <ls>Śiva B. 9. 18</ls> also <ls n="Śiva B.">5. 11, 59</ls>. कुसुमबाणसखेन सुखासितं विपिनमापि न मानमनेहसा <ls>Rām. Ch. 4. 11</ls>.
